answer: Farming becomes a pearl bet on surviving 67 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the velvet schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 67 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
